title: Belmont Resorts — claimed by thegentlemen
description: AU · Hospitality · belmontresorts.com Belmont Resorts is a small boutique hotel in McLeodganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh, operating as Hotel Satovari Pride on the Strawberry Hills with panoramic views of the snow-capped Dhauladhar mountains. It has just 14 rooms across four categories from Deluxe to Premium Gold corner suites with private balconies, mini-fridges and sunrise-sunset views from both sides. Position
